agency: Arizona Oil and Gas Conservation Commission
cadence: irregular (the Commission edits the layer as it updates its records; it states no schedule)
name: Arizona
note: Wells counted by their spud date, not by permit: the Commission's layer has no approval or filing date. Arizona drills very few wells, and the recent ones are helium, not oil (the fluid split says so). Only wells with a Commission permit number count. The newest spud the layer records is June 2023; the months since are zeros because none is recorded (the permits issued since then are listed as permitted, planned, extended or expired), up to the layer's last edit on September 24, 2026. Re-entries, reworks and amendments are not told. Spud dates arrive late, so the last two months are left off.

source.name: Oil and Gas Wells layer (ArcGIS, the Commission's well map)
